# montecarlo_microsoft_fabric_credentials (Resource)

Microsoft Fabric credentials are the Entra ID service principal Monte Carlo signs in to a Fabric SQL endpoint with, stored for Microsoft Fabric connections to use. The client secret is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_client_id` (String) Client ID of the Entra ID app registration Monte Carlo signs in with.
- `app_client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret of the app registration. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `app_client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `app_client_secret_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `db_name` (String) Warehouse or lakehouse to connect to. It goes unquoted into the connection string Monte Carlo builds, so it cannot contain whitespace or any of `;`, `{`, `}` and `=`.
- `host` (String) Hostname of the Fabric warehouse or lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint, as Fabric shows it under SQL connection string, such as `abc123.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com`. It goes unquoted into the connection string Monte Carlo builds, so it cannot contain whitespace or any of `;`, `{`, `}` and `=`.
- `port` (Number) Port of the SQL endpoint. Fabric serves it on 1433.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant the Fabric workspace belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
